record.paper: Ramsey and Turán numbers of sparse hypergraphs

dossier_meta.paper: Ramsey and Turán numbers of sparse hypergraphs
dossier_meta.context_text: For 3-uniform hypergraphs the paper's argument gives $r(H;q)\leq\exp^{(2)}(O_q(d\log d))n$ in general, and removes the $\log d$ factor when the 1-skeleton has bounded chromatic number. Conjecture 6.1 asks to remove that factor for every 3-uniform hypergraph of first skeletal degeneracy $d$.
